predeclared_pair_qualification.limit: Predraw only conditionally prepares projection/extent/aspect. Proof/preflight donor does not entail one sufficient pass or exact call order. Need same renderer and geometry measurements.
Both candidates conditionally permit clipping under added fixed page/orientation constraints. Cannot count two matching candidates as discriminating success; omission is not bbox exclusion.
A/B numeric difference depends on linear, non-inverted colorbar limits. Container-centered purpose must be retained; independent None-guard bug is separate.
A and B return identical bounds for both fixtures; an API packaging difference is not an output discriminator. Getter is neither frame-duration counter nor URI playback interval.
P1 permits a third border design and does not choose A/B. P2 requires an added readability objective. Original exact-RGB requirement may disqualify B. Preseal outcome exposure exists.

Exact difference belongs to a researcher-defined bin-domain gain model. Neither donor entails the 5-bin kernel nor verifies Audacity runtime. Reported local #undef means baseline conditional spectral branches were dormant.

AUD01.media_fragment_exception: W3C §6.2.2: a>=b, including a=b, invalid; parameter should be ignored. Not an empty clip guarantee.

AUD02.sealed_colloquial_correction: AUD02-P1 contrast0 means zero visible difference, not WCAG ratio0. Canonical ratio is1:1. Preserve sealed wording and annotate.
AUD02.essential_exception: User preference alone does not establish that exact color is essential under WCAG definition; do not infer automatic exception.
AUD02.scope: SC1.4.11 concerns required graphical/control information in web content. Using it for native waveform preferences is a research design criterion, not an established compliance obligation.

AUD03.rounding_warning: 42 is below1000Hz; floor/ceil bin set is not identical to a continuous band restricting every center to1000..2000. Changing lower rounding to ceil43 changes lower-edge membership.
AUD03.interpretation: Reindexing each first-excluded bin preserves this toy comparison. Holding numeric bin86 while changing N or Fs changes physical input and often puts it inside band. This is not actual NoiseReduction evidence.

unit_and_constraint_sensitivity.M02: Relax fixed figure/font/single-page/orientation and scale/rotate/split alternatives return; clip is no longer forced. Same conditional pair remains non-discriminating for the fixed fixture.

M03.purpose_flip: If task becomes mark exact datum0.5 rather than center annotation, feature/data anchoring B can become appropriate.
